quest.title: Special Friends
quest.description: Your Saurian buddy wants to make some new friends...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, are we interrupting its mealtime? It sure looks annoyed...

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: "I have neither goals I must reach, nor have I urgent desires. I am a happy shepherd. I care only for alpacas, for the seasons and things that grow, for the cool breeze and rains..."

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: That's my favorite song. What do you think? Pretty good, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ah. It's something furry. Something furry is blocking your path...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? So you're all friends, then?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Someone who seems in charge of watching the Alpacas comes over and calms the Yumkasaurus...

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, calm yourself, Half-Baked. See, that's why you've got your name, making rash judgments like you always do.

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: Don't worry about him, he's just got too strong a sense of duty. Gets all antsy when there are strangers about. But it's also thanks to that dedication that I've got an easy time over here taking care of these Alpacas.

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: Anyway! What brings you people to my little spot?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Just roaming about. You know, on our adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: Ah, adventurers, then! That said, I imagine Half-Baked saw you as dangerous folks with the scary, scary auras.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Paimon didn't know that Yumkasaurs could do that. And here we were thinking the Alpacas were about to get attacked! Guess it was all just a misunderstanding, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: Aye, and a common one it is, too. I know my fella looks fierce, but he's pretty close to yon' Alpacas. Why, I'd even call them friends!

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: Hmm? What's up, little guy? You wanna be friends with them too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, guess so. But yeah, thinking about it, you usually just hang out with the two of us. Some animal friends...

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: That would do 'im good, yes. Would be quite the adorable scene, too, don't you think — a lil' Tepetlisaur surrounded by Alpaca friends? Me, I could chow down on three bowls of Blazed Meat Stew before I got bored of it.

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: Still, that'll depend on whether my Alpacas agree or not. Friendship's not to be forced, and all. Wouldn't you say so, Half-Baked?

choices.text: #Oho, what's this? Someone doesn't wanna get friendly with our {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, hey, no need to get all defensive! Let's just give {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} a chance to try this out for himself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kids only grow when they learn how to get by through their own hard work, right?

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Well, your Tepetlisaur's got confidence coming out of its ears, or I'm blind. Guess I'll head back and get some rest. Just holler if there's trouble...

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Wait, you know what? Might as well holler for Half-Baked instead. He's the Alpaca expert here, after all... Just kidding. Alright, little fella, you've got this. Good luck!

choices.text: #It's alright. Whatever happens, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s still got us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon knows you're trying to be nice just in case things don't work out... But there's no need to be this pessimistic from the get-go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Kids need more encouragement to grow up strong and healthy! That's right, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, you can do it! Paimon believes in you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Is this one holding a grudge because of our misunderstanding with Half-Baked?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh well, not much we can do about that now. C'mon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. Let's try our luck elsewhere!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like there's much hope here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, uh, these things happen, you know? Don't feel down, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. You've still got a chance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh boy, looks like we interrupted a feeding session... Don't worry, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. This was just bad timing, that's all! Let's try our luck elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's this other Alpaca doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong. Is it trapped down there?

talks.objective: See what your Saurian buddy has found
Use the wooden planks to create a path
Use the wooden planks to create a path

dialogues.speaker: Energetic Alpaca
dialogues.text: (Looks like it's still mad at us...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #Only after much "Rawr! Rawr!"-ing encouragement from {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} does the timid Alpaca climb back up using the freshly-laid wood plank path...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #Faced with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s enthusiasm, the timid-looking Alpaca seems unafraid, instead bending down and gently touching {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} with its nose...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! Guess that means you're getting on great, huh?

choices.text: #A friend of yours, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, is a friend of mine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon's too... Wait, when did this become a competition?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, it's kinda dangerous for this Alpaca to be out here completely on its own. We'd better go tell Wactana what's going on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Also, Paimon's sure she'll be happy to hear that {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s made a friend, too!

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: I see you're back, little fella. How did it go? Make any Alpaca friends?

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: Haha, aren't you a happy camper? Why, you're even making me feel all jolly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, Wactana, shouldn't you be a bit more concerned about what happens to the Alpacas? The one {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} made friends with was in a real tight spot back there.

dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: That so? Guess I gotta talk to Half-Baked real quick then, tell it to take more care.

choices.text: You're way too chill about this.

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: I mean, I am living the dream! C'mon, be happy for me and stuff!

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: #Ah, yes. If {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s fond of the Alpaca toy over by the side, I can let y'all have it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Guess {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} doesn't know what "standing on ceremony" is, huh. Thanks then, Wactana!

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Eh, no biggie. And if you wanna drop by again, you're always welcome.

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Sure... But he was always a massive worrywart. If I took him off Alpaca guard, he'd start losing fur from stress, I tell you!

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: So this arrangement's best. Job satisfaction for him, free-and-easy living for me. Win-win, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: "Half-Baked"
dialogues.text: Four... It's hiding again. Where has it gone?
